title: Peter Munch-Ellingsen: Why I wrote my own keyboard firmware in Nim (NimConf 2021)
summary: Peter Munch-Ellingsen explains at NimConf 2021 why he wrote his own keyboard firmware in Nim instead of using QMK or Arduino. He shows that the resulting firmware is very small.
why: Pointed to as a real-world example of Nim in embedded work, mostly by the author himself.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: This presentation about writing keyboard firmware in Nim may be helpful, if you're willing to give Nim some more consideration
